Having spent over a decade in film and television, her body of work includes a multitude of projects; both British and international. Projects include Shadow and Bone (Netflix), Strike Back (Sky/Cinemax), Sliced (Dave) - and the upcoming Red Sonja Reboot and Amazon's Heads of state.
